column1: All grounding must be checked against the appropriate grounding drawings and standards as follows:

Check sizes of grounding conductors used.  Grounding loop: #4/0 stranded bare copper conductor.  Individual ground connections to equipment: #2/0 stranded bare copper conductors (or as specified on drawings).  DCS ground: #2/0 insulated (green) stranded copper conductor.  Magmeter ground: #2 insulated (green) stranded copper conductor.
Check accessible ground rods (at test wells) for proper material.  Must be ¾” diameter copper or copper clad steel rod.

Check individual ground connections to all pieces of equipment (i.e. building steel, columns, motor base plates, transformers, tanks, etc) including proper PVC protection sleeves and proper support where required.
Check ground bars for proper size, material and support.
Check insulated ground bars for proper size, material and support.
